mappings.rationale: KBLI-2020 code 38120 ('Pengumpulan Limbah Berbahaya' — general hazardous-waste collection) is a genuine content-driven SPLIT in KBLI-2025, confirmed independently in BOTH crosswalk directions rendered as images: Lampiran 5 p.170 (2020->2025 table) and Lampiran 10 p.363 (2025->2020 table) both show the single 2020 row fanning out to two distinct 2025 rows — 38121 'Pengumpulan Limbah Berbahaya Selain Limbah Radioaktif' and 38122 'Pengumpulan Limbah Radioaktif'. This is not a title-similarity artifact: the OSS 2025 parent-group (3812, 'Pengumpulan Limbah atau Sampah Berbahaya') uraian, read live from oss/relasi.json parents[], explicitly enumerates 'bahan radioaktif' as one of several hazardous-substance classes the pre-split group always covered (alongside explosive/oxidizing/flammable/toxic/irritant/carcinogenic/corrosive/infectious materials) — i.e. radioactive waste was a semantically distinct sub-case bundled inside the single 2020 code all along, now separated into its own subgroup. 38122's own uraian (canonical.json) narrows precisely to identifikasi/penanganan/pengemasan/pelabelan/pengangkutan of radioactive waste to a pengelola limbah, mirroring the 'radioaktif' carve-out language of the parent 3812 uraian word-for-word in substance, while 38121 retains the residual non-radioactive hazardous-waste scope. The split also tracks a real regulatory divide, not a cosmetic one: this code's own l4_bali field states radioactive-waste collection is a BAPETEN/BUMN-reserved strategic sector closed to private/PMA capital — a distinct national nuclear-safety regime with no analogue for the general B3 waste retained under 38121.

mappings.rationale: Sibling leg of the same BPS-confirmed SPLIT, documented for completeness so the mapping is not truncated to a single target (the failure signature this adjudication is explicitly guarding against). 38121 'Pengumpulan Limbah Berbahaya Selain Limbah Radioaktif' retains the general hazardous/B3-waste collection scope of the former 38120 minus the radioactive-waste subset now carved out to 38122 — the residual set from the same 3812 parent-group uraian (explosive/oxidizing/flammable/toxic/irritant/carcinogenic/corrosive/infectious materials, explicitly excluding 'bahan radioaktif'). Not the D1 target code of this batch entry (no canonical.json for 38121 was in this evidence set to cross-check its own per_skala independently) — recorded here only to make the split's two-way shape explicit rather than implicit.

payload.notes:
SPLIT confirmed with HIGH confidence: two independent-direction BPS Vol.2 crosswalk renders (Lampiran 5 p.170 and Lampiran 10 p.363) agree pixel-for-pixel on the same 1-to-2 fan-out (38120 -> 38121 + 38122), and the OSS 2025 parent-group-3812 uraian (oss/relasi.json) independently corroborates that 'bahan radioaktif' was always a named sub-case of the pre-split hazardous-waste group, so this is a genuine uraian-level split, not a title coincidence.

Overall confidence downgraded to MEDIUM because the licensing/PP28 layer could not be image-verified: pp28/ABSENT.json records a full-corpus hunt (21 files, 11,208 pages scanned) for source code 38120 that came back verdict=absent — no PP28 lampiran render exists in this vault to confirm the row-level licensing text backing canonical.json's own declared provenance (pp28_sources=["38120"], kbli_2020_source="38120", aggregation_note="Dati da 38122 + 1 codici figli PP28", _source="BPS_7_2025 + PP28_2025"). Recorded per instructions as an ABSENT layer rather than guessed.

licensing_inherits=true because canonical.json visibly and explicitly declares its per_skala licensing facts (perizinan, persyaratan, kewajiban, kewenangan) were aggregated from the PP28 entry tied to the KBLI-2020-vintage code 38120 (the pre-split parent), not from a distinct 2025-native 38122 PP28 row. Since that row could not be located as a rendered image in this batch, D2 (image-verified row extraction against the actual PP28 2025 lampiran, searching under a broader file range or the possibility that PP28's lampiran indexes by the split codes 38121/38122 rather than legacy 38120) is needed before the per_skala content can be trusted as radioactive-waste-specific rather than generic-B3 boilerplate carried over unchanged from the combined 2020 entry.

needs_quarantine=true for three compounding reasons: (1) this is a genuine SPLIT, the exact shape the workflow doc flags as highest wrong-remap risk; (2) the PP28 evidence layer backing the code's own declared licensing provenance is absent, so the per_skala content is unverified against source imagery; (3) a soft internal-consistency flag worth a human/D2 look — per_skala kewenangan is 'Bupati/WaliKota' and one risk-tier's parameter text still frames scope in generic 'Limbah B3'/'rumah tangga' (household) terms, which reads as carried-over general-hazardous-waste language rather than freshly authored radioactive-waste-specific licensing text; this is plausible (OSS NIB-level administrative authority can sit with Pemda while BAPETEN issues a separate technical clearance, and 'Persetujuan Teknis' is already listed as a Tinggi-tier requirement) but not confirmed, and should not be waved through without the D2 pass.

OSS layer: detail.json + relasi.json present and consistent with the 2025 code and its 3812 parent group; ruang_lingkup and umku endpoints are recorded ABSENT (404, per oss/ABSENT.json) — not guessed, recorded as absent per instructions.

reasons: Bidirectional crosswalk independently confirmed: Lampiran 5 p.170 (2020->2025) shows 38120 fanning to both 38121 and 38122; Lampiran 10 p.363 (2025->2020) shows both 38121 and 38122 mapping back to 38120 -- a clean 1-to-2 SPLIT, and D1's quoted row text (including the source's own 'Radiokatif' typo) matches my own pixel read exactly.

OSS relasi.json parent-group 3812 uraian independently confirmed to explicitly list 'bahan radioaktif' among the hazardous-substance classes covered pre-split, corroborating the SPLIT rationale rather than a title-similarity artifact.

canonical.json's own declared provenance fields (pp28_sources=['38120'], kbli_2020_source='38120', status_mapping='MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE') independently confirmed to point at the legacy pre-split code, supporting licensing_inherits=true as an accurate reading of the record's own metadata, not an invented claim.

pp28/ABSENT.json independently confirmed: full-corpus hunt (21 files, files_scanned 394930-394950, 11208 pages) for source 38120 returned verdict=absent, matching D1's stated PP28-layer gap and resultant MEDIUM confidence / needs_quarantine=true, recorded honestly as absent not guessed.
oss/ABSENT.json independently confirmed ruang_lingkup and umku both 404/absent, matching D1's note verbatim.

Internal-consistency flag independently verified: per_skala[0].parameter text does read '...bersumber dari rumah tangga...' (household-sourced) generic B3/Limbah B3 language, and kewajiban lists generic collection/K3 equipment with no radioactive-specific safety items -- a real, correctly-hedged (not overclaimed) observation that legitimately supports the quarantine recommendation.
l4_bali field text independently confirmed to match D1's characterization in substance (BUMN/BAPETEN-reserved strategic sector, closed to PMA, NB-3 28 June 2026).
No divergence found on any checkable evidence point; the ABSENT/NOT_APPLICABLE layers were correctly reported as absent by D1 rather than fabricated or guessed.
